name: bos-memory
description: BOS Memory for Claude Code: the memory tools, what memory knows at the start of each session, and automatic capture of decisions, commitments and rules from your sessions.

url.title: BOS Memory address
url.description: Your BOS Memory server, without /mcp, e.g. https://memory.example.com. Shown on the console's Connections page.

token.title: Agent token
token.description: A token starting bosm_, made on the console's Connections page (choose Claude Code). Kept in your system keychain, and in a copy only you can read in ~/.bos-memory for the slash commands.
